description: Use this when a visitor asks whether or when a ride broke down: with ride_id, each outage of that ride over the last 1 to 30 days with start and end times; without ride_id, every outage at the park today including rides down right now.

days.description: Park-local days of one ride's history including today, 1 to 30. Defaults to 7. Ignored without ride_id.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.

ride_id.description: Optional ride ID for one ride's outage history.

name: parky_get_ride_outages
title: Get ride outages
